company.name: AutoStream
company.tagline: Automated video editing tools for content creators

policies.title: Refund Policy
policies.description: Refunds are available within the first 7 days of subscription. No refunds are issued after the 7-day window has passed.

policies.title: Customer Support Policy
policies.description: 24/7 customer support is exclusively available to Pro plan subscribers. Basic plan subscribers receive email support during business hours.

details.pro_support: 24/7 priority support via chat, email, and phone

faqs.question: Can I upgrade from Basic to Pro at any time?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can upgrade to the Pro plan at any time. The price difference will be prorated for the remainder of your billing cycle.

faqs.question: What platforms does AutoStream support for publishing?
faqs.answer: AutoStream supports direct publishing and optimization for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and Twitter/X.

faqs.question: Is there a free trial?
faqs.answer: AutoStream offers a 7-day money-back guarantee. If you are not satisfied within the first 7 days, you can request a full refund.

faqs.question: What video formats are supported?
faqs.answer: AutoStream supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and MKV input formats. All exports are delivered as optimized MP4 files.
